# lowering

```go
import "github.com/lucasavila00/tgo/internal/lowering"
```

Package lowering turns checked TGo expressions into ordinary Go code.

The goal is to replace TGo syntax while keeping the source program's behavior. A rule can need several Go statements for one source expression. For example, use\(first\(\), fetch\(\)\!, last\(\)\) must save first, check fetch, and return on failure before last runs. Lowering keeps these statements with their values until the enclosing operation places them where they execute.

Each [rule package](<https://github.com/lucasavila00/tgo/tree/main/internal/lowering>) owns a language decision: error propagation, collection construction, or branch results. [Shared operations](<https://github.com/lucasavila00/tgo/blob/main/internal/lowering/shared/readme.md>) own evaluation order, typed storage, and Go control flow. Rules use those operations so the same source operation follows the same execution rules in every feature.

Checked source facts and selected operations are complete before rewriting starts. Rewriting creates its own state and copies changed syntax. Each file owns its imports and binding changes. Each function owns its returns and jumps. Nested rules use the current function; source closures get a new one. This ownership keeps a nested error return in the correct source function.

## type After

After receives references to the evaluated expression results.

```go
type After func(results []ast.Expr) []ast.Stmt
```

## type Site

Site identifies an expression in the original source. Offsets are bytes.

```go
type Site source.Site
```

## type Source

Source contains the original syntax and its type information.

```go
type Source struct {
    Package *packages.Package
    Sites   []Site
    // contains filtered or unexported fields
}
```

### func Load

```go
func Load(dir, pattern string) (*Source, error)
```

Load reads and type\-checks one Go package selected by pattern in dir. It records expression positions for later statement insertion.

### func SourceFromCheckedPackage

```go
func SourceFromCheckedPackage(p *checker.Package, dir string) (*Source, error)
```

SourceFromCheckedPackage records expressions from private source checking.

### func SourceFromPackage

```go
func SourceFromPackage(p *packages.Package, dir string) (*Source, error)
```

SourceFromPackage records expression positions and insertion limits in a checked package. File names are relative to dir; a package with type errors returns an error.

### func \(\*Source\) InsertAfter

```go
func (s *Source) InsertAfter(site Site, after After) (map[string][]byte, error)
```

InsertAfter returns Go files with the callback's statements after the selected expression. The callback receives saved results; the original syntax tree stays unchanged.

### func \(\*Source\) LowerPropagations

```go
func (s *Source) LowerPropagations() (map[string][]byte, error)
```

LowerPropagations replaces checked TGo operations with ordinary Go. It returns formatted file contents by absolute path without writing files. It reports an error if any accepted operation was not replaced.
